name: Physics
tagline: Forces, fields, and everything in motion.
intro: Mechanics, light, relativity and the occasional thought experiment, from falling apples to collapsing stars.

name: Math
tagline: Proofs, patterns, and the logic underneath everything.
intro: Ideas that hold every other science together, explained with pictures before symbols wherever we can.

name: Chemistry
tagline: Bonds, reactions, and why matter behaves the way it does.
intro: What atoms want, what they do to get it, and how that shapes everything from table salt to ice.

name: Biology
tagline: Cells, genes, and the machinery of living things.
intro: How life copies itself, powers itself, and occasionally swallows a bacterium and keeps it for two billion years.
